evidence.finding: In dPink1 RNAi flies, there is a significant reduction in the PPL1 cluster and a modest reduction in the PPM cluster.
evidence.citation: Yang et al. 2006, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

extracted.quote: As shown in Fig. 4 B, 25-day-old dPink1 RNAi flies raised at 29°C showed a significant reduction of TH+ neurons in the lateral protocerebral posterior (PPL1) cluster. The dorso-medial protocerebral posterior (PPM) cluster [also known as dorsomedial cluster (DMC)] also showed a modest reduction of neuronal number, whereas the other clusters were relatively unaffected (Fig. 4F).
extracted.tier_reason: Counted per cluster with stats provided in text and Figure 4.
